function.arguments: {"thought":"Architecture: dependency-free Node 22 HTTP server using node:sqlite, static assets, JSON REST, and SSE. Persist immutable full-workbook revision snapshots plus per-cell attribution history and server-recognized sessions. On save, derive edits by diffing submitted cells against the exact base revision, validate the complete trust boundary before a transaction, then merge non-overlapping edits into the current snapshot. Reject same-cell divergence as conflict. Client uses a custom div grid (not per-cell inputs), one transient editor, formula parser/evaluator, transactional undo/redo, clipboard/range/fill/find, autosave, revision preview/restore, and SSE presence/remote changes. This is the simplest architecture that satisfies atomic revisions and concurrent different-cell merge without external dependencies."}
function.name: think
